messages:
maria: Thanks for joining today's all-hands — quick clarifications and action list. Recording + slides: https://redwood.example.com/ah/177221 (rec) and https://redwood.example.com/slides/q2-roadmap.pdf :point_right:
maria: Short recap: Dedicated GA bumped ~2w for a perf soak; Private pilot starts Apr 6; Optimize beta in May. Details/owners below.
leah: can we add one concrete sentence to the partner-facing slide deck about the Dedicated timing change? legal asked.
maria: done, slide 4 has a one-line note "Dedicated GA: mid-May tentative" and I uploaded v2. link above.
carlos: who is running the perf canary and when? raised in Q&A.
leah: eng-runtime (@tim) to run canary Tue 9am PT. success criteria: p95 within 10% baseline and <0.1% error increase over 48h.
tim: will post the runbook in #eng-runtime and attach the dashboard once started.
anya: Optimize beta telemetry question: will prompts be sent unhashed? privacy flagged this in the Q&A.
maria: telemetry is opt-in for the beta. default is hashed/anonymized metrics; full-text evals require explicit customer consent. Security will publish an FAQ.
devops-bot: Action created: AH-177221-1 (canary runbook) assigned to @tim; AH-177221-2 (slides note) assigned to @maria; AH-177221-3 (optimize metrics doc) assigned to @anya.
carlos: thanks. can we get a short changelog bullet about the Dedicated delay in #partners so the sales folks have something to send?
maria: yes — I'll drop a 2-line changelog in #partners by EOD.
leah: Hiring follow-up: People Ops will share the updated role list and prioritization doc by tomorrow.
anya: Product will publish the Optimize prioritization doc and initial metric thresholds by Friday.
maria: Closing here 12: ping owners if you hit blockers and I'll reopen the thread. :raised_hands:
